item.title: Show HN: HNFiltered, Hacker News minus stories that waste your time
item.summary: Like everybody, I'm getting sick of seeing slop on HN. So like a good little hypocrite, I vibe coded a little CF Worker that uses the fantastic HTMLRewriter + Luna to filter low-quality posts. It leaves popular and controversial stories alone. Everything else still goes directly to Hacker News. Not my proudest project lol; drop feedback in the comments and I’ll throw it back into Codex, see what we get ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ Source: https://github.com/mintshelf/hnfiltered.com Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49303703 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
